1. Choose your mode

My instances is the regular Minecraft client. Lost versions opens the EBALIA archive.

2. Create an instance

Choose a name, game version and loader. Vanilla is the original game; Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge support mods. Worlds and settings stay separate. The catalog refreshes at startup and every 30 minutes. Existing instances keep their game version to protect your worlds.

3. Add mods

In Discover mods, choose your instance and search for Sodium, dynamic lights, FallingTree or Veinminer. Review dependencies and confirm installation. Published compatibility does not guarantee that all mods work together.

4. Save your favorites as a pack

Use Save mods as a pack on your instance. Apply it to another instance from My packs. We look up builds for its game version and loader; unavailable mods are listed before downloading. Incompatible JARs are never copied. Local mods must be identifiable on Modrinth; disabled mods are excluded.

5. Play

Add an account, install Java and press Play / Install. After installation finishes, press Play. If Java is missing, the launcher tells you which version the game requires. Choose its path and memory in instance settings.

Troubleshooting

Open Instance settings → Log. Repair verifies game downloads again. Removing an instance moves it to local trash with its worlds. Forge and NeoForge use their official installers and require Java before installation. Lost versions may require Wine, older Java or original packages that are no longer available.
